confidence_notes: FX is the RBA's published 18 Nov 2026 observation (0.6720 USD per AUD). The 19 Nov figure looked provisional, so I did not use it. Coffee, beer and restaurant meals come from crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, Expat Exchange), which differ by source. I found no cocktail or wine prices, so those are estimated from the local relationship to beer: wine glass slightly below beer plus a small premium, cocktail about 2x beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. Bern has few hostels and budget hotels, so those are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Bern's own crowd-sourced price data, with Swiss cities such as Zurich and Basel as the regional comparison. Bern is somewhat cheaper than Zurich or Geneva.
